comparison.baseline: Parent main editor/presentation integrations and CSS restored and rebuilt; no working timer baseline exists.
limits: Direct logged-in original appearance and exact timer limits/reset/add semantics remain unverified.
More-menu entry, automatic popup in other windows and collaborator/cross-device transport remain unfinished.
Physical-device and cross-browser comparison remain required.
Original synthesized music/cues are local free equivalents; no copied recordings or network audio.
